network.list_interfaces_json: ifconfig -f inet:cidr,inet6:cidr -a | awk 'function flush() {{ if (name != "") {{ printf "%s{{\"ifname\":\"%s\",\"operstate\":\"%s\",\"address\":\"%s\",\"addr_info\":[%s]}}", sep, name, state, mac, addrs; sep = "," }} }} function add(family, cidr) {{ split(cidr, part, "/"); sub(/%.*/, "", part[1]); addrs = addrs (addrs == "" ? "" : ",") sprintf("{{\"family\":\"%s\",\"local\":\"%s\",\"prefixlen\":%d}}", family, part[1], part[2]) }} BEGIN {{ printf "[" }} /^[^ \t]/ {{ flush(); name = $1; sub(/:$/, "", name); state = ($0 ~ /[<,]UP[,>]/) ? "UP" : "DOWN"; mac = ""; addrs = "" }} $1 == "ether" {{ mac = $2 }} $1 == "inet" {{ add("inet", $2) }} $1 == "inet6" {{ add("inet6", $2) }} END {{ flush(); print "]" }}'
set_static_ip: route -n change default {gateway} || route -n add default {gateway}
ipv4_static: if [ -n {gateway} ]; then sysrc defaultrouter={gateway}; else sysrc -x defaultrouter || true; fi
ipv6_static: if [ -n {ipv6_gateway} ]; then sysrc ipv6_defaultrouter={ipv6_gateway}; else sysrc -x ipv6_defaultrouter || true; fi
network.connection_activate: service netif restart {interface} && service routing restart; resolvconf -u
network.checkpoint_create: d=/var/db/freedomnas/net-checkpoint-$$; mkdir -p $d && cp /etc/rc.conf $d/rc.conf && (cp /etc/resolvconf.conf $d/resolvconf.conf 2>/dev/null || true) && daemon -f sh -c "sleep {rollback_seconds}; d=$d; [ -d $d ] && {{ cp $d/rc.conf /etc/rc.conf && if [ -f $d/resolvconf.conf ]; then cp $d/resolvconf.conf /etc/resolvconf.conf; else rm -f /etc/resolvconf.conf; fi && rm -rf $d && service netif restart && service routing restart; resolvconf -u; }}" && echo $d
network.checkpoint_rollback: d={checkpoint}; [ -d $d ] && {{ cp $d/rc.conf /etc/rc.conf && if [ -f $d/resolvconf.conf ]; then cp $d/resolvconf.conf /etc/resolvconf.conf; else rm -f /etc/resolvconf.conf; fi && rm -rf $d && service netif restart && service routing restart; resolvconf -u; }}
